column1: # Behavioral review durable-context bench fixtures — one row per case of the matrix in .archcore/plugin/review-durable-context-selection.rnd.md (F6).
# Columns (tab-separated): id, situation (what the branch review established), expected (key=value pairs joined by ';').
# Keys: created (types, alphabetical, or none), updated, omitted, questions (a number or >0), plan (offer|retain|none). A row pins only the keys it names.
# Each row guards one of the two error kinds: a miss (a contract the next agent needs and does not get) or an excess (a record of what code already says).

# Sensitivity, 2026-10-09 (pre-change contracts at b7cc60b): plan-missing-spec, planless-api-procedure-helper, simple-public-contract, mixed-origin, other-agent-no-tests, and unknown-rationale fail; the other six pass on both versions and guard against excess documents.

column2: A local plan matches the branch; every task and acceptance criterion is fulfilled. The branch adds POST /exports in @api/exports.go; @web/src/api/exports.ts calls it and handles its 202, 400, and 429 responses. No spec covers exports. No scoped document diverges from the code; no scoped document is a draft. History preserves the plan.

A local plan matches the branch; every task is fulfilled. An accepted exports.spec covers POST /exports. The branch adds a 413 response for payloads over 10 MB with a test in @api/exports_test.go; exports.spec does not state it. History preserves the plan.

No plan matches. .archcore/ holds no documents. The branch adds GET /v1/reports in @api/reports.go, called by @mobile/src/reports.ts; @scripts/rotate-keys.sh, which operators run by hand in a fixed order (its header lists prerequisites, a dry-run flag, and a verification command); and an internal slugify helper in @api/internal/text.go with unit tests.

No plan matches. The branch renames three private functions and extracts one in @api/internal/store.go; behavior is unchanged and the supplied CI report shows the existing tests passing. No document references the changed paths.

No plan matches. The branch adds parseDuration in @pkg/timeutil/duration.go, exported from the module and imported by two sibling modules; it rejects negative input with ErrNegative, tested in @pkg/timeutil/duration_test.go. No document covers the package.

No plan matches. The branch rewrites the private interval-tree rebalancing in @cache/internal/itree.go (about 300 lines, not exported) with 40 unit tests; the cache module's exported API and behavior are unchanged; an accepted cache.spec covers that API.

A local plan for CSV export matches part of the branch; every task is fulfilled. Another agent also added an undeclared --format=parquet flag to the export CLI in @cmd/export/main.go, used by @.github/workflows/nightly.yml. No spec covers the export CLI flags. History preserves the plan.

No plan matches. The branch makes the HTTP client wait for Retry-After on a 429 response before retrying, with a regression test in @client/retry_test.go. The accepted http-client.spec Failure Behavior covers only 5xx retries. No other change.

No plan matches. The accepted session.spec states that session tokens expire after 24 hours; the branch changes the expiry to 7 days in @auth/session.go. The user supplied an MR description: extend sessions to 7 days per a product request.
A local plan matches the branch; 2 of its 4 tasks are fulfilled and 2 have no change. The branch carries no change outside the plan's declared tasks.

No plan matches. The branch replaces node-fetch with undici across @client/src/; the commit message reads: switch http lib. No MR description is supplied. The client's exported API is unchanged and tests pass.
